name: PuzzleMe for WordPress
author: Amuse Labs

sections.description:
PuzzleMe™ by Amuse Labs is the leading digital platform to create, edit, manage, publish and track smart games like crossword, sudoku, word search, jigsaw, and quiz among others. Use our WordPress plugin to publish your puzzles with a shortcode.

Start creating and publishing your puzzles in 3 simple steps :
1. Log in to PuzzleMe.
2. Create a puzzle and copy the WordPress shortcode from the “Preview & Publish” page.
3. Paste the shortcode in your page or post and hit Publish.

PuzzleMe is a registered trademark of Amuse Labs. By using PuzzleMe, you agree to our terms of service and privacy policy.
sections.faq:
Which puzzles do you support?

PuzzleMe supports many smart games including crossword, word search, sudoku, jigsaw, WordroW, jigsaw, and quiz. See our game pages for a full list of puzzles.

Do I need to create an account?

You can initially create a game without logging in, however, to save your progress, edit, manage, and publish the puzzle, you will need to be logged in to PuzzleMe. For personal and non commercial usage, please use one of the available social login methods on this page.

Do puzzle solvers need to create an account?

Your puzzle solvers do not need to create an account with PuzzleMe.

What is your pricing?

PuzzleMe’s WordPress plugin is free to use. Please visit our pricing page for subscription plans and feature availability.

What if I have other questions about PuzzleMe?

Please contact us.
